step.cmd: Determine if written authorization from Service Canada has been provided to the client:

ul.li: If no, go to step 6.

If yes, and the client is calling to declare that the financial institution will not redeem the stale-dated warrant, provide the client with the following information:
The replacement time is 5 working days if the client has signed up for direct deposit. If the client did not sign up for direct deposit, the replacement time is 7 to 13 working days for a warrant.
The stale-dated warrant must be returned.
Go to step 8.

step.cmd: While the client is on the line:

ul.li: Obtain the contact information for the financial institution.

Advise the client that a letter will be sent as authorization for the financial institution to redeem the stale-dated cheque. Once the letter is received, the client must take the letter and the stale-dated cheque to the financial institution.
Advise that if the financial institution refuses to redeem the stale-dated cheque, the client is to contact the Service Canada Call Centre and request a payment replacement.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the F-00-00-00 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Text - Free text (1612): Type “This letter has been sent as authorization for [name of financial institution] to redeem EI benefit cheque # [warrant number] issued to [client’s name], on [issue date], in the amount of [payment amount]. To confirm the above request, please contact [officer’s name] at [telephone number], Monday to Friday, between the hours of [hours of work].”
Go to step 10.

step.cmd: Complete the INS5207 form as follows:

ul.li: SIN: Enter the SIN.
HRCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
Requester: Enter the 7-digit user code.
Week Code(s): Enter the w/c of the payment to be replaced.
Warrant No(s).: Enter the payment reference number that appears in the Payment Summary (MN19) information screen.
Amount(s): Enter the payment amount that appears in the Payment Summary (MN19) information screen.
Name: Enter the client’s surname and given name.

Address: Enter the client’s address as follows:
On the first line, enter the street address.
On the second line, enter the city, province and postal code.
Telephone number: Enter the client’s telephone number.

Action: Type “The client had received the warrant issued on [date]. Original warrant is now stale-dated. The client has been advised to return the original warrant to the local Service Canada Centre.”

step.cmd: In NWS, create an IPOC REV WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate language.

Destination — SCC: Select the IPOC based on the region in which the claim is located in FTS:
Atlantic: Select 1826 Moncton IPOC .
Ontario: Select 3056 Belleville IPOC .
Quebec: Select 2642 Montreal IPOC (3) .
Western Canada and Territories: Select 5903 Vancouver IPOC .
End User: Select Next available user .
Issue: Select Payment replacement .
BPC: Type the BPC of the claim.
Comments: Type “Payment replacement.”
Details: Copy and paste the information from the INS5207 form . INS5207 form
Obtained by: Select the appropriate method.
Obtained from: Select the appropriate source.
Source details: Enter the source details.
Select Save .

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Replacement warrant .
Comments: Type “Warrant stale-dated.”

Details: Select the appropriate option:
Financial Institution cannot redeem the stale-dated warrant: Type “The financial institution declared that warrant [warrant number] issued on [warrant issue date] for the weeks of [YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD] cannot be redeemed because it is stale-dated. A payment replacement request was submitted to IPOC. The client has been informed and understands that: The replacement time is 5 working days if the client has signed up for direct deposit. If they didn’t sign up for direct deposit, the replacement time is 7 to 13 working days for a warrant. The client must return the original warrant to Service Canada.”
Letter of authorization sent to the client: Type “A letter authorizing the financial institution to redeem warrant [warrant number] issued on [warrant issue date] for the weeks of [YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD] was sent to the client on [date]. The client was advised to take the letter and stale-dated cheque to the financial institution and it will be redeemed.”

step.cmd: If there is a WI, complete it.
